summary: Preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes obfuscated 727KB bundle
details: The package's declared preinstall script (`node setup.mjs`) downloads the Bun runtime from github.com/oven-sh/bun releases, extracts the executable, chmods it executable, and immediately invokes it against a sibling file `math_init.js` shipped in the tarball. `math_init.js` is a 727KB obfuscated Bun-format bundle (string-array-shuffle unpacker `WV8StW`, ~2000-entry char-code decoder table `hc1jfK9`, `// @bun @bun-cjs` prelude) that is not human-auditable without runtime execution. `setup.mjs` itself is transformed with obfuscator.io-style hex-named locals (`_0xXXXXXX`) and property-lookup indirection tables (e.g. `_0x19328d.YCZJE(execFileSync, "ldd",...)`). This behavior — pulling an alternate language runtime at install time in order to execute an opaque, obfuscated bundle — is inconsistent with the stated purpose of a Vue 2 UI component library, cannot be evaluated by inspecting Node-readable source, and evades Node-based static/dynamic scanners. Any installer running `npm install` on this package executes attacker-controlled code under Bun with the installer's user privileges before any application code runs.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
